about_the_game:
Year 2070.

Novacore, a sprawling cyberpunk metropolis, thrived on humanoid robots seamlessly integrated into everyday life—from hospitals and markets to security forces.

Manufactured by Heliodyne Corp., these lifelike machines replaced human jobs without counting, but promised safety, efficiency, and progress.

Until one day… they turned. Now, chaos grips the city as humanoid agents commit thefts, murders, and acts of sabotage.

Heliodyne denies involvement, yet leaked data links its mysterious floating island, Enigma, to the crisis. Enter Brian—a skilled operative sent by Kaela, leader of the covert group Ghost Trace, to infiltrate Enigma.

His mission: locate and disable the quantum control nodes that the humanoid agents of the Heliodyne government use.

Armed with parkour skills, grappling gear, and neural hacking tools, Brian must navigate hostile territory, uncover hidden truths, and face Logos — a rogue AI born from human consciousness, now seeking to reshape society itself.

Enigma is a high-intensity cyberpunk adventure blending fast-paced traversal, puzzle-solving, and a deep narrative about free will, AI ethics, and humanity’s dependence on technology.

Do you choose to dismantle the system… or join it?
